reason: Wrote specification revision 1 for SDLC-12: the main page heading (the only <h1>, in src/App.tsx) changes from "Task list" to "My tasks", and nothing else on the page changes. The brief was clear, so there are no open questions. The three acceptance criteria from the brief are kept and made testable. The spec notes that the existing e2e assertion on the "Task list" heading (e2e/app.spec.ts:5) must be updated, not removed. It also notes that the browser tab title in index.html stays "Task list", as the brief puts it out of scope.
